name: Project Work Progress
query:
SELECT 
    project_customer as "Project",
    object_title as "Object",
    task as "Task", 
    status as "Status",
    expected_start_date as "Start Date",
    expected_end_date as "End Date",
    project__object_size_in_hecter as "Total Work",
    total_compleated_work_till_now as "Done Work",
    (project__object_size_in_hecter - total_compleated_work_till_now) as "Remaining Work"
FROM 
    `tabProject Setup`
WHERE 
    docstatus = 0
    AND status = 'Open'
